purpose: One tool or command the agent invoked, shown in the conversation (AI Elements Tool, Cloudscape progressive steps): a row with the tool name in code font, an optional plain description, and a status (`Waiting`, `Running…`, `Completed`, `Failed`, `Denied`), with the call's input and output in a collapsible panel. It is the record of what the agent did; authorization before it runs is `ActionConfirmation`.
useWhen: An agent calls a tool, an MCP server, an API or a CLI command during a response, and the reader should see what ran and what came back.
avoidWhen: Asking the reader to allow a call → `action-confirmation` (then a `tool-call` records it).
A long-running job outside a chat → `progress` / `status-indicator` on the resource.
related: action-confirmation` — the authorization step before a sensitive call.
status-indicator` — the status the row shows.
code-block`, `key-value-pairs` — what goes in the input and output slots.
bestPractices: Name the tool exactly as it is (`list_workloads`) and describe it in plain words (`Listing your workloads`).
Collapse details by default; open them on error so the reader sees why.
Redact secrets from inputs and outputs.
